correctness.rationale: The complement of Petersen KG(5,2) is L(K5), and Ind(P)=Cl(L(K5)). For every finite simple graph G, the star-clique subcomplex A_G is covered by simplices A_v with single-vertex intersections and nerve G; H2(A_G)=0, H1(A_G)=H1(G). Every additional clique of L(G) is exactly a triangle formed by three pairwise incident edges without a common endpoint. The relative chain sequence produces natural integral isomorphism H2(Cl(L(G)))=ker(triangle-edge oriented boundary Z^{T(G)}->Z^{E(G)}). Under H⊂G this kernel is intersection with a coordinate direct summand, so inclusion is primitive and H2 quotient torsion-free; this is not deduced merely from homotopy equivalence nonnaturality. For K5, exact four-simplex augmented chain exactness gives rank-four triangle-cycle lattice generated by five tetrahedral boundaries t_i=(-1)^i d_i with unique sum-zero relation; a missing edge {u,v} forces equality of the three coefficients on complementary labels, giving rank |intersection of missing edges| for nonempty F, rank four otherwise. Independent 1024-mask enumeration of simplicial H2 mod2 over every induced restriction matched all ranks (958 rank-zero, 55 rank-one, 10 rank-two, 1 rank-four). This supports, not alone proves, integral saturation and S5 sign-twisted augmentation quotient.
